description.value: A full-service, year-round RV park on the edge of Fort St. John offering hot showers, laundry, and 82 serviced sites; geared to RVs with no tent rate listed, but a practical amenity stop for cyclists passing through the Peace region.

address.value: 10688 Alder Cres, Fort St John, BC V0C 1H0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is accessible and confirms the phone number (250-787-5500 matches OSM +1-250-787-5500) and postal code (V0C 1H0), but lists the street as 'Alder Cres' and the city as 'Fort St John' rather than OSM's 'Alder Road, Charlie Lake'; the website value is used per rule 12 and flagged as a concern. Showers ('Hot Showers') and laundry (cashless, multiple payment methods) are explicitly confirmed on the website; no cyclist-specific amenities such as hiker/biker sites, bike tools, or pump are mentioned anywhere.
concerns: Address discrepancy: OSM lists '10688 Alder Road, Charlie Lake' but website shows '10688 Alder Cres, Fort St John, BC V0C 1H0' — both street name and city differ; website value used.
No mention of tent camping, hiker/biker sites, or any cyclist-specific infrastructure anywhere on the website or in OSM tags; facility appears oriented exclusively toward RVs.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is primarily an RV park with no cyclist-specific amenities (hiker/biker sites, bike storage, tools, pump) mentioned; it offers showers and laundry useful to touring cyclists but may not meet WWC inclusion thresholds without confirmation of tent/cyclist accommodation.

wow_evidence: full-service, year-round RV park... hot showers, laundry; no tent rate listed
